Derive the golden/copper penny decomposition of the M&O rate

txs_derive_pennies.Rd

Under HB3 (2019), a district's maintenance-and-operations tax effort decomposes into Tier One (the Maximum Compressed Rate), golden pennies (the first 8 cents of effort above the MCR – highest yield, not subject to recapture), and copper pennies (effort above the golden pennies – lower yield, recaptured). All rates are dollars per $100 of taxable value.

Usage

txs_derive_pennies(x, golden_cap = 0.08)

Arguments

x

A data frame with numeric mcr and mo_rate columns (and optionally is_rate), one row per district-year – typically from txs_get_tax_rates(). NA MCR (no MCR input supplied) yields NA penny metrics.

golden_cap

Golden pennies cap in dollars per $100; 0.08 under current law.

Value

x with added columns tier_one_rate, golden_rate, copper_rate, enrichment_rate, golden_pennies, copper_pennies, and (if absent) total_rate.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
txs_get_tax_rates(2024) |> txs_derive_pennies()
} # }
